title: Export and documentation
content:
# Export and documentation

Use **Export as** to create output for the currently open model.

## SVG

SVG creates a scalable graphic of the currently visible BPMN level or the DMN decision overview. An open BPMN subprocess is exported with its detailed flow; a collapsed subprocess remains summarised. BPMN SVG files use the process name and export timestamp in their file name.

## PDF documentation

PDF documentation summarises model information in the selected language. For BPMN it always shows the top-level process first and places existing subprocesses with their flow graphics under **Activities**. Large graphics are output on a dedicated landscape page. For DMN it includes the decision overview, input data, decision logic, and available test cases. Sections without data are not output empty.

Large DMN models can take a little longer to generate. The status bar shows a progress indicator while the PDF is being created. If creation fails, the status message provides a clear explanation and any available technical details.

## Markdown in descriptions

BPMN and DMN descriptions are interpreted as Markdown in PDF documentation. Supported syntax includes headings from `#` through `######`, paragraphs, ordered and unordered lists, **bold text**, *italic text*, `code`, and [links](https://example.com). Unsupported or incomplete syntax remains text and does not prevent export.

title: Troubleshooting and notes
content:
# Troubleshooting and notes

## A file cannot be saved

Check the location and write permission; if needed, choose **File → Save as**.

## DMN test cases cannot run

Execution requires the local DMN Runner. If it is unavailable, reinstall BPM Modeler or contact your administrator.

## Test-case JSON cannot be imported

The file must contain valid JSON and match the active model.
